title: Nuevas prioridades
goal: Read how US policy toward Latin America shifted from a single anti-communist axis to trade, counter-narcotics, and democracy promotion -- Bush's June 1990 Enterprise for the Americas Initiative and the 1989 Andean Initiative.

items: State the single axis US policy had revolved around for decades.
Name the three new axes that replaced it.
Describe what Bush launched in June 1990.
Explain what the Andean Initiative funded.
Use girar en torno a to name a policy's central axis.
